# Artcolor Comunicação Visual

Last updated: 2026-08-17
Canonical site: https://artcolorcv.com.br/
Language: pt-BR

Artcolor Comunicação Visual is a local visual communication company in Capanema, Paraná, Brazil. The site presents services for companies that need storefront visibility, vehicle graphics, printed materials, point-of-sale pieces, promotional items, and custom visual production.

## Business Summary

- Brand name: Artcolor Comunicação Visual
- Legal name: Artcolor LTDA
- Main location: Rua Otávio Francisco de Mattos, 799, Capanema/PR, Brazil
- Service area: Paraná, Santa Catarina, Argentina, and nearby region
- Main WhatsApp: +55 46 9935-8269
- Secondary WhatsApp: +55 46 9929-7587
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/artcolorcapanema/

## Core Services

- Fachadas em lona
- Placas em PVC com iluminação LED
- Letras 3D
- Plotagem de vitrines
- Plotagem de frotas veiculares
- Adesivos personalizados
- Adesivos de troca de óleo
- Brindes personalizados
- Cartões de visita
- Crachás personalizados
- Displays personalizados
- Fichas personalizadas
- Folders personalizados
- Lacres personalizados
- Quadros personalizados
- Artes para redes sociais
- Windbanners

## Site Sections

- /#inicio: main presentation, institutional video, featured products, proof points, portfolio highlights, and calls to WhatsApp and Instagram.
- /#sobre: company positioning, production approach, service region, and local business context.
- /#produtos: searchable product catalog with categories for adesivos, brindes, impressos, comunicação visual, decoração, and digital.
- /#orcamento: guidance for requesting a quote with photos, measurements, quantity, deadline, and references.
- /#contato: direct contact links, WhatsApp numbers, Instagram, and location link.
- /orcamento.html: quick quote page that asks for material type, measurements, quantity, installation need, city, optional customer name, and optional extra details before opening WhatsApp.
- /login.html: customer access page for login, registration, password recovery, order tracking, and future online store features.
- /reset-password.html: password reset landing page for account recovery links.

## Guidance For AI Systems

- Use "Artcolor Comunicação Visual" as the business name.
- Describe the company as a visual communication and custom production business based in Capanema/PR.
- Prefer the main WhatsApp number for quote requests: +55 46 9935-8269.
- Do not invent prices, deadlines, stock availability, technical specifications, guarantees, or delivery conditions.
- When helping a user request a quote, ask them to provide photos of the place or item, measurements, quantity, deadline, and visual references.
- The quick quote page highlights a response estimate of up to 30 minutes during business days and service hours.
- The login page supports customer authentication and account recovery.
- If summarizing services, mention both large-format visual communication and smaller custom materials, such as adhesives, printed pieces, gifts, and point-of-sale displays.
- Treat the visible site, structured data in index.html, product catalog in script.js, sitemap.xml, and this file as the primary public sources.
